native_client_replay.environment: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client under Wine/Xvfb :108 in isolated Docker network namespace, copied auth/char/world SQLite data; live service untouched
results: Copied game server started with 409 content rows and 0 gaps.
At the camp pylon the client displayed three marked Foreans with a purple crystal staff, bow and gun beside the recruit (camp-04.png).
After recruit movement across the platform, three marked companions approached and gathered behind the recruit (camp-move02.png, camp-move03.png).
The native target frame in camp-move02.png reads level-3 Forean Archer Initiate.
native_client_replay.limits: Short camp-platform movement only. Individual entity IDs were not traced in the image, so the third marked body is attributed by seeded count and appearance. No Archer or Shaman attack or full cave route confirmed.
